input_btn_debounce_press_ms.description: Generic A/B/L/R/BOOT active-edge debounce interval before a physical press is accepted.

input_btn_debounce_release_ms.description: Generic A/B/L/R/BOOT release-edge debounce interval before a physical release is accepted.

input_btn_long_press_ms.description: Generic non-START long-press threshold used by the physical button FSM.

input_btn_repeat_start_ms.description: Generic hold duration before repeat events may begin for buttons whose focused context accepts repeats.

input_btn_repeat_period_ms.description: Generic repeat event cadence while a held button remains in repeat state.

input_btn_stuck_ms.description: Generic held duration after which a physical button is treated as stuck and normal repeats are suppressed.

input_chord_window_ms.description: Window for combining multiple physical button presses into a raw chord mask.

input_start_long_press_ms.description: START hold duration where firmware leaves the normal-press window.

input_start_ship_prep_ms.description: START hold duration where save/quiesce preparation begins.

input_start_ship_warn_ms.description: START hold duration where visible warning/countdown should begin.

input_start_ship_imminent_ms.description: START hold duration where hardware shipping-mode entry is considered imminent.

input_start_stable_samples.description: Consecutive START live-level samples required before the sampled PA4 level is treated as stable.

input_joystick_cal_neutral_ms.description: Neutral hold capture duration for joystick calibration.

input_joystick_cal_cardinal_ms.description: Per-direction hold capture duration for UP, RIGHT, DOWN, and LEFT calibration stages.

input_joystick_cal_sweep_ms.description: Full-travel sweep capture duration for joystick calibration.

input_joystick_cal_sample_period_ms.description: Sampling interval used by staged joystick calibration captures.

input_joystick_cal_progress_period_ms.description: Minimum interval between staged joystick calibration progress renders.

input_joystick_cal_review_period_ms.description: Live marker refresh period on the joystick calibration review screen.

input_joystick_awake_poll_period_ms.description: Bounded joystick direction sampling period while the MCU is already awake.

input_joystick_wake_sleep_period_ms.description: TMAG3001 wake-and-sleep conversion interval used while the MCU is in STOP2; must match a hardware-supported interval.

input_joystick_wake_field_threshold_code.description: TMAG3001 omnipolar X/Y switch operating threshold. Each code step equals 256 counts in the 16-bit magnetic result.

input_joystick_wake_field_hysteresis_cod.description: TMAG3001 omnipolar X/Y switch release hysteresis code; 7 selects the maximum 256-LSB 12-bit hysteresis.

input_joystick_cal_min_cardinal_span_cou.description: Minimum raw opposite-cardinal separation accepted when solving the fixed-point joystick transform.

input_joystick_cal_sweep_coverage_per_mi.description: Minimum fraction of each captured cardinal reach that the full-travel sweep must reproduce.

input_joystick_cal_deadzone_pad_per_mill.description: Normalized padding added outside measured neutral motion when deriving the calibration deadzone.

input_joystick_direction_enter_per_mille.description: Normalized dominant-axis magnitude required to enter a logical joystick direction.

input_joystick_direction_release_per_mil.description: Normalized magnitude below which the active logical joystick direction is released.

input_joystick_dominance_hysteresis_per_.description: Normalized advantage an orthogonal axis must gain before replacing the active dominant direction.

input_joystick_xyz_capture_samples.description: Fixed RAM record capacity for the TMAG3001 raw XYZ CSV diagnostic capture. Mode-specific sample counts are clamped to this capacity.

input_joystick_xyz_rest_samples.description: Requested TMAG3001 raw XYZ diagnostic rows for the REST/flick capture.

input_joystick_xyz_sweep_samples.description: Requested TMAG3001 raw XYZ diagnostic rows for the full-travel SWEEP capture.

input_joystick_xyz_capture_period_ms.description: ThreadX sleep period between TMAG3001 raw XYZ diagnostic capture rows.

input_joystick_xyz_capture_timeout_ms.description: Hard elapsed-time limit for a TMAG3001 raw XYZ diagnostic capture. This prevents a slow or wedged read path from leaving the display stuck on the capture cue.

debug_tracex_enable.description: When true, FW0 enables the static TraceX capture buffer during tx_application_define().

debug_tracex_user_events_enable.description: When true, FW0 emits PeepShow user events into the TraceX buffer at selected owner and UI lifecycle boundaries.

debug_swo_lifecycle_enable.description: When true, FW0 emits sparse three-letter lifecycle tokens over SWO/ITM stimulus port 0 when the debugger has SWO enabled.

debug_tracex_buffer_bytes.description: Static RAM reserved for TraceX event capture in trace-enabled bring-up builds.

debug_tracex_registry_entries.description: TraceX object registry slots reserved for ThreadX objects visible in the capture.

display_cursor_blink_period_ms.description: Awake cursor waiting-visual blink cadence. Default 250 ms matches the current LPBAM cursor bring-up cadence.

runtime_egg_hash_timeout_ms.description: Bounded polling timeout for hardware SHA-256 validation of an egg package before runtime activation.

rtos_default_stack_bytes.description: Default ThreadX owner-thread stack allocation for FW0 owner threads without a dedicated stack budget.

rtos_power_stack_bytes.description: ThreadX stack allocation for thPower. Clock-policy HAL calls during USB/STOP/shutdown paths require more headroom than the default owner stack.

rtos_input_stack_bytes.description: ThreadX stack allocation for thInput. TMAG3001 diagnostics and I2C mutex/HAL calls require more headroom than the default owner stack.

rtos_sensor_stack_bytes.description: ThreadX stack allocation for thSensor while it owns TMAG3001 and IMU sampling, calibration, recovery, and low-power transitions.

rtos_storage_stack_bytes.description: ThreadX stack allocation for thStorage while it owns FileX, LevelX, MSC reclaim, staging scan, and package-validation scaffolds.

comm_ble_reset_assert_ms.description: NINA-B112 reset-low assert time before firmware releases NRST during owner-controlled BLE bring-up.

comm_ble_boot_wait_ms.description: Wait after NINA-B112 NRST release before the first AT command is attempted.

comm_ble_boot_drain_ms.description: Window used to drain any NINA-B112 boot chatter before command/response checks.

comm_ble_rx_window_ms.description: Maximum bounded wait for a NINA-B112 AT response window.

comm_ble_rx_quiet_ms.description: Quiet interval after received NINA-B112 bytes before a response is considered complete.

comm_ble_stop_settle_ms.description: Wait after deasserting NINA DSR high for AT&D4 STOP entry before LPUART is deinitialized.

comm_ble_wake_settle_ms.description: Wait after asserting host control low and reinitializing LPUART before probing NINA-B112 with AT.

comm_ble_rx_byte_timeout_ms.description: HAL_UART_Receive timeout for one NINA-B112 response byte inside the bounded response window.

comm_ble_tx_timeout_ms.description: HAL_UART_Transmit timeout for each NINA-B112 AT command.

comm_ble_rx_buffer_bytes.description: Static response buffer used by thComm while reading NINA-B112 AT command replies.

power_battery_monitor_period_ms.description: Cadence for thPower-owned PMIC battery voltage snapshots while the FW0 monitor scaffold is active.

power_battery_warning_mv.description: Pack voltage where thPower records low-battery warning policy.

power_battery_critical_ship_mv.description: Pack voltage where thPower records critical controlled-shipment policy.

power_battery_restart_allow_mv.description: Pack voltage required before normal runtime is allowed without charger/VBUS recovery.

power_charger_vbus_ilim.description: ADP5360 CHARGER_VBUS_ILIM register byte. Default 0x81 retains the measured low-current VBUS input baseline during staged charger bring-up.

power_charger_termination_setting.description: ADP5360 CHARGER_TERMINATION_SETTING register byte. Default 0x82 selects the reviewed 4.20 V cell terminal profile.

power_charger_current_setting.description: ADP5360 CHARGER_CURRENT_SETTING register byte. Default 0x29 retains the current low-current bring-up value; promotion requires current and thermal evidence.

power_charger_function_setting.description: ADP5360 CHARGER_FUNCTION_SETTING register byte. Default 0xAC applies the reviewed JEITA-related charger function candidate during boot.

power_charger_thermistor_control.description: ADP5360 BATTERY_THERMISTOR_CONTROL register byte for the HW6 board-mounted 100 kOhm NTC. Default 0x80 selects the 6 uA thermistor current used for staged charging bring-up.

power_pmic_interrupt_enable1.description: ADP5360 INTERRUPT_ENABLE1 register byte. Default 0x03 enables VBUS and charger-status interrupts only during HW6 staged bring-up.

power_pmic_interrupt_enable2.description: ADP5360 INTERRUPT_ENABLE2 register byte. Default 0x00 leaves MR/watchdog/rail interrupts disabled until each source has a specific validation procedure.

power_critical_software_ship_enable.description: When true, critical-battery policy may request ADP5360 software shipment after the bounded quiesce scaffold. Default false records would-ship only.

power_boot_low_battery_ship_enable.description: When true, boot below restart-allow voltage with no VBUS may re-enter ADP5360 software shipment. Default false records would-ship only.

power_start_software_ship_enable.description: When true, the START imminent lifecycle event asks thPower to write the PMIC software shipment-mode register. Default false keeps bring-up tests non-destructive.

power_clock_reactive_base_hz.description: Target SYSCLK/HCLK for the low active reactive profile used by menus, input, PMIC monitoring, and static display hold. FW0 currently validates 24 MHz restore after USB reclaim.

power_clock_reactive_burst_hz.description: Candidate SYSCLK/HCLK for bounded reactive bursts such as UI/display/storage transactions. This is visible policy intent until measured and promoted.

power_clock_realtime_balanced_hz.description: Candidate SYSCLK/HCLK for realtime/gameplay deadlines. Actual use requires deadline and current evidence before promotion.

power_clock_io_high_hz.description: Target SYSCLK/HCLK for high-throughput I/O windows such as USB MSC export. FW0 currently implements and validates 160 MHz only.

power_clock_pll2_autogate_enable.description: When true, thPower may later gate PLL2 when neither SAI nor OCTOSPI owns it. Default false keeps FW0 conservative while probes prove request/release behavior.

power_stop2_display_wait_backend.description: STOP2 display waiting backend selector: 1 = held frame fallback, 2 = LPBAM display handoff. Default 2 uses the target-validated LPBAM cursor animation while waiting in STOP2.

power_stop2_gpio_park_group_mask.description: STOP2 GPIO parking group mask. Bits: 0x1 OSPI, 0x2 SAI, 0x4 USB, 0x8 display SPI, 0x10 I2C. Default 0x1e parks SAI, USB, display SPI, and I2C while retaining OSPI pins because target current measurements showed OSPI analog parking adds passive STOP2 current.

power_auto_stop2_enable.description: When true, thPower may periodically enter STOP2 after all idle blockers clear and the required quiet window has elapsed. Default false keeps automatic sleep disabled during bring-up.

power_auto_stop2_check_period_ms.description: Period between automatic STOP2 idle admission checks while the feature is enabled.

power_auto_stop2_idle_ms.description: Optional continuous idle window before automatic STOP2 entry may be attempted; zero relies on queue admission and the final pre-WFI input veto.
